title.narrative: Rehabilitation and Modernization of Irrigation Infrastructure Schemes (IFAD) in Iraq

description.narrative: The project’s overall objective is to contribute to the revitalization of agriculture while building resilience to climate change in four Southern Governorates of Iraq.\n\nThe project aims to increase water availability and irrigation efficiency to sustain water supply for agricultural production in the selected governorates, mitigate the impact of climate change namely the reduction in precipitation and increasing water scarcity by supporting irrigated agricultural production, enhance the profitability of the supported small farms and agri-businesses in orderimprove the income of the rural vulnerable farmers.
